subject: Next steps & scheduling: technical deep-dive and security touchpoint
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Use case: FinLytics wants to add a low-latency, cost-predictable summarization and insight layer into the customer-facing analytics portal.
- Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data, 1s median response target for short summaries, and aggressive cost targets for high query volume.
- Must-haves: SOC2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option for certain tenants, and procurement-friendly T&Cs.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (45–60m) with platform/security to validate network and SSO requirements.
2) Procurement/Legal call to cover contract milestones and purchasing cadence.

Can you confirm who from FinLytics should join those two sessions (security contact + procurement contact)? Below are a couple of windows that work for our engineering team next week — happy to add other slots if none of these fit:
- Tue 2026-03-24 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-03-25 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 2026-03-26 08:30–09:30 PT

I attached a short discovery notes doc and a one-pager on pricing so your finance team has context.

If those windows work I can send calendar invites and loop in our security lead (Grace O'Connor) and solutions engineer (Neha Kapoor).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: discovery_notes_finlytics.docx, redwood_pricing_summary.pdf

- 40–45m: Next steps & owners (all)

Joining details: I'll send a calendar invite from our team once Elena confirms the 03/24 slot. If the 10–11 PT window fills up on your side, other times we can pull in: Wed 03/25 13:00 PT or Thu 03/26 08:30 PT — or feel free to share a Calendly link and I'll pick a slot.
